title: Seriously needs updating
text:
The location is great and we didn’t spend too much time in the room, thankfully… I’m guessing it hasn’t been updated since 2010, the tiny TV in the corner was laughable and it felt like going back in time. Every time you went into bed you could hear the springs jingling around in the mattress.

hotelName: Park Avenue Bayswater Inn Hyde Park
title: Exceptional
text: We had 2 single rooms for an overnight stay to go to a Show at the Bloomsbury Theatre. This hotel is very conveniently located close to Paddington Station and the Tube. The staff are very welcoming, friendly and professional and we were called in our rooms after arrival to check all was well. The lower ground single rooms are very small, but the cleanliness was 5 star and they were more than adequate for an overnight stay. The breakfast next morning was very good. For a longer stay, I would prefer a larger room, perhaps on a higher level in the hotel  but overall we were very satisfied with our stay and would recommend the Park Avenue Bayswater Inn to other travellers.

hotelName: Park Avenue Bayswater Inn Hyde Park
title: Christmas trip
text:
1. No Booking Found on Arrival

When we arrived, the hotel had no record of our reservation, despite having received a confirmation from Agoda. This was completely unacceptable and caused significant distress and embarrassment at check-in.

2. Payment Not Received / Left to Resolve the Issue Myself

We were told that payment had not been received, and I was effectively left to resolve the matter myself between Agoda and the hotel. This should never happen to a guest—especially not one who has paid in full in advance.

3. Room Facility Issues

Even after check-in was eventually sorted, the issues continued:
	•	Our room keys failed repeatedly, requiring multiple trips back to reception.
	•	At breakfast, there was no milk, no cutlery, and generally very poor service.

4. Very Early Morning Calls

To add to the frustration, we received two calls at 7:50am on our last morning, waking us up and disrupting the only morning we had to relax.
